name: Cargo Zeppelin Tender
description: A small VTOL craft that shuttles personnel and small cargo between zeppelins and ground stations. The airship equivalent of a harbor boat — unglamorous, essential, and piloted by crews who spend more time in the air than on the ground. Tenders dock at the ventral port of a zeppelin and can transfer up to 8 passengers or 1,000 kg of priority cargo without the airship needing to descend to a mooring mast. Watching a Tender dock with a moving zeppelin in high winds is one of the most impressive displays of piloting in Meridian 88.
common_usage: Zeppelin crew transfer, priority cargo, passenger embarkation/disembarkation without mooring.
story_hooks: A Tender pilot docks with a cargo zeppelin and finds the crew gone — the airship is on autopilot with no record of where the crew went
Tender pilots witness things from the air that ground dwellers never see — patterns in the city lights, movements at night, the shape of something in the lake
